appStoreConnect.notes: Apple Developer Agreement was accepted by Vambah and Apple Developer Program membership activation cleared enough for App Store Connect to open. Vambah registered the Apple Developer App ID for com.vsillah.reversrrebuild, and App Store Connect now exposes the Bundle ID as ReversR Rebuild - com.vsillah.reversrrebuild. Automation staged the App Store Connect New App form with iOS, ReversR Rebuild, English (U.S.), the registered Bundle ID, SKU reversr-rebuild-001, and Full Access, then stopped before the final Create button because it creates the persistent App Store Connect app record. App Store Connect Apple ID collection remains pending until that record is created.

googlePlay.notes: Google Play Console app record exists and opens to the ReversR Rebuild dashboard. Store listing, data safety, app content, internal testing, and production access are not complete.

signoff.notes: Partial console evidence only. No production submission is approved.
